import re, numpy as np
# extract body via markers

def parse_demo(text, marker, rows, cols):
    i=text.index(marker)
    sub=text[i+len(marker):]
    # until next Demo pair/output maybe use expected row count after newline
    lines=sub.strip().splitlines()
    vals=[]
    for line in lines[:rows]:
        arr=[int(x) for x in line.split()]
        if len(arr)!=cols: print('bad line',len(vals),len(arr),line)
        vals.append(arr)
    return np.array(vals)
